checks.description: ElastiCache replication groups must have in-transit encryption enabled to protect cache data in motion
checks.impact: Without TLS, all Redis/Memcached traffic between the application and cache nodes is transmitted in plaintext on the VPC network, exposing session tokens, PII, and other sensitive cache values to network-level eavesdropping
checks.resolution: Set transit_encryption_enabled = true on the aws_elasticache_replication_group resource. Note: changing this setting requires replacing the replication group
checks.errorMessage: ElastiCache replication group does not have in-transit encryption enabled (transit_encryption_enabled must be true)
